###################################
# New Intelligence: Geopolicy - colonial zones (v0.11). GENERATED by tools/gen_colonial_zones.pl - edit the table there.
# gp_cz_setup (global, once): every land location of a zone gets var:gp_cz_anchor = the zone's anchor location; the
# anchor gets var:gp_cz_id, the flags gp_cz_nw / gp_cz_asia / gp_cz_africa / gp_cz_g1..g6 and joins the global list
# gp_cz_anchors. The yearly zone pass (gp_col_world_update, gp_colonies.txt) stores the leader and the shares on the anchor.
###################################

gp_cz_setup = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = gp_cz_ready } }
		set_global_variable = gp_cz_ready
		gp_cz_setup_1 = yes

# 1 cuba - Cuba (anchor yateras)
gp_cz_setup_1 = {
	location:yateras = {
		set_variable = { name = gp_cz_id value = 1 }
		set_variable = gp_cz_nw
		set_variable = gp_cz_g3
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = gp_cz_anchors target = this }
	}
	area:cuba_area = { every_location_in_area = { limit = { is_land = yes } set_variable = { name = gp_cz_anchor value = location:yateras } } }
}
